title: Renewal
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text or code.
sideBSummary: Unrationed Event named RENEWAL, code P2-02b. Place a character ability worth 2 or less on a Character card currently in play. The ability may be placed over a scar. Destroy this card after use. Play at any time. Not an action.

rules: Play at any time. Not an action.
Place one character ability whose cost is 2 or less onto a Character card that is currently in play.
That ability may cover a scar.
Destroy this card after use. It does not go to the Player discard pile.
notes: The recon report gives this card to a player to add to their hand when the package is opened.
Worth 2 or less is the ability's printed cost.
